messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] .csv file to analyse
parts:
GGIR is not designed for analysing the submission checklists for the journal of neuroscience research ;)

Please ask Inacio, Alan or someone else from Pelotas to help you. They have experience with GGIR and may be able to help you quickly.
If you do run into a problem then please post it here: https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/issues. This email list is mainly intended for generic questions/discussions and not for help with specific problems.

If you do report a problem then please add as much detail as you can, as in: what accelerometer brand, study design, things you tried to fix it yourself, error messages you get. In that way you make it easier for others to help you.

Thanks
